name: @wayfinder/editor-client
description: Wayfinder's service blueprint visual editor as host-agnostic Lit custom elements (graph canvas, definition JSON editor, validation) with no assumptions about hosting or persistence. Not published to a registry — consumed by other Wayfinder projects as a pre-built ES module bundle shipped inside the Wayfinder.Editor NuGet package's static web assets, the same way any Umbraco backoffice extension bundle is loaded by URL at runtime.

scripts.build: tsc && vite build --config vite.service-blueprint-editor.config.ts && vite build --config vite.wayfinder-elements.config.ts
scripts.docs:screenshots: CAPTURE_DOC_SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test service-blueprint-graph-visual.spec.ts service-blueprint-editor-gateways.spec.ts stage-action-editor.spec.ts support-system-action-editor.spec.ts service-blueprint-editor-validation.spec.ts service-blueprint-editor-definition-tab.spec.ts service-blueprint-editor-help.spec.ts
